column1: # Game profile of Fate/hollow ataraxia REMASTERED (Switch, update 1.0.2 = v131072, NACP display version "1.0.2 b723").
# TYPE-MOON's Fuzz engine (smash::fw), SDK 16.2.6, rendering through Nintendo's OpenGL ES / EGL stack (subsdk0, not loaded): main resolves GL and EGL entry points via eglGetProcAddress
# (including EXT aliases and glGetShaderSource), which the host's GL layer implements on Metal (dm/gfx/gl/hle_gl.m). subsdk3 is NintendoSDK_movie.
# The shaders are 78 GLSL sources the game builds at run time: no game file holds them, so the NSP script captures them by booting the game on the Mac (gl_capture.tsv lists them) and
# dm/gfx/tools/gl_shaders.py translates them offline; the host finds each by the hash of its text.

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk3 = NintendoSDK_movie). subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_OpenGL), subsdk1 (GLSLC) and subsdk2 (NintendoSDK_Vulkan) are not loaded
# The NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource, so the game has no virtual address memory; main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB − 12 MB of bss (a 3328 MB heap region)
# no NVN shaders: the NVN tables stay empty (gl_shaders.py writes the GL library and its table, not the profile)

column2: Fate/hollow ataraxia REMASTERED has no NVN shaders (its GLSL shaders go through the GL layer)
